source.title: Tom Ford Gives a 30-Year-Old Man an Eyebrow Makeover | Project Upgrade | GQ

tips.text: Have a real weekend wardrobe: don't just wear your work suit without the tie, or jump straight from suit to gym clothes.
tips.why: A suit minus tie is still a work uniform.

tips.text: Spend a bit more for better quality; clothes look better, feel better and last longer.
A badly fitting suit ages you; fit matters more than having a slim cut.
tips.why: Poor fit makes you look older and generic.
